Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: character reference sheet for a public GitHub project, used as a binding reference for every later frame of the project
Primary request: one wide sheet that fixes the figure of Themis so she can be reproduced identically in every later scene — same face, same hair, same robe, same scales, same sword, same materials.
Input images: Image 1 is the immutable Pantheon style reference; Image 2 is the required family-signature column.
Subject: Themis as a white-marble sculpture, shown four times in one row on the same ivory ground and at the same height and scale: front view, three-quarter view turned to her left, full profile view facing left, and back view. Beside the row, three isolated attribute studies at larger scale: the sword alone, the scales alone, the head alone.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape. A classical white-marble column stands at the far right as the family signature, clearly separated from the figures. The four full-length views stand in a single straight row across the middle of the frame with equal spacing, each fully inside the frame with clear space above the head and below the base. The three attribute studies sit in a lower band under the row: the sword laid horizontally, the scales hanging free, the head in three-quarter view. Generous empty ivory space, nothing overlapping.
Style/medium: premium restrained 3D marble sculpture render, warm ivory Apple-like presentation, white marble, physically plausible materials, museum reference plate feeling
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from upper left, long gentle shadows, calm and confident, identical lighting on every view
Color palette: ivory #F3EFE8, bright ivory #FBFAF6, white marble, muted gold #C9A87A for the metal fittings only, charcoal #3E3A36
Constraints, and these are the identity of the figure and must be identical in all four views:
- A smooth white marble band covers her eyes as a blindfold, tied at the back of the head, never lifted and never absent.
- Hair parted in the centre, gathered into a braided crown around the head, with one thick braid falling forward over her left shoulder to the chest.
- A classical sleeveless chiton belted at the waist, with a mantle draped over the left shoulder and falling behind the left arm.
- The scales are muted gold with two shallow round pans on thin gold chains, the beam level and balanced, carried in her raised left hand.
- The sword has a WHITE MARBLE blade and muted gold grip, crossguard and pommel. It is always lowered, point down, held loosely in her lowered right hand or resting point-down beside her. The blade is never steel, never silver, never fully gold.
- She stands barefoot on a round marble base.
- Every view shows the same person: same proportions, same face, same hair, same robe folds direction, same sword and scales.
- Anatomically correct hands with exactly five fingers, natural finger lengths and one clearly readable thumb, fingers not fused.
- Preserve the reference style; highest final quality; maximum resolution.
Avoid: dark background, black background, neon, purple gradient, smoky cinema lighting, heavy bronze, metallic or plastic marble, watermark, owl, helmet, open eyes, a raised or pointed sword, a steel or silver blade, an all-gold sword, different hairstyles between views, extra or missing fingers, fused fingers, labels or callout lines
Text (verbatim): No readable text, no letters, no digits, no measurement marks, no callout labels anywhere in the image.
